# Vendored zstd decoder

The decompression-only single-file build of [zstd](https://github.com/facebook/zstd),
used when the build host has no system libzstd. It lets every build of the client
decode RP_CAP_COMPRESS_ZSTD (DeBeOS-RDP #23), so the capability is always offered,
and only offered because the decoder is always present.

| | |
|---|---|
| upstream | zstd **v1.5.7**, release asset `zstd-1.5.7.tar.gz` |
| tarball sha256 | `eb33e51f49a15e023950cd7825ca74a4a2b43db8354825ac24fc1b7ee09e6fa3` (matches upstream's `.sha256` asset) |
| generated by | `build/single_file_libs/create_single_file_decoder.sh` from that tarball, unmodified |
| `zstddeclib.c` sha256 | `5eb38abe0a7eea13674b312a006df72002d4192f0f0b4d09e6f03fb927a1f3d0` |
| `zstd.h` | `lib/zstd.h` from the same tarball, sha256 `9b4bc8245565c98ccfc61c07749928b57e7c0f6fddb0530c4f6aa1971893d88b` |
| license | BSD (`LICENSE`, copied from the tarball); zstd is dual BSD/GPLv2 and is used here under BSD |

No file here is edited by hand. To update: download a newer release tarball,
check its sha256 against the release's `.sha256` asset, rerun the script above,
copy `zstddeclib.c`, `lib/zstd.h` and `LICENSE`, and update this table.

The build uses a system libzstd when one is found and this file otherwise
(`make HAIKU_REMOTE_ZSTD=vendored` / `-DHAIKU_REMOTE_ZSTD=VENDORED` forces it).
